source.title: Competitor used visibly broken headphones during attempt
source.content: A competitor was found to be wearing headphones while competing. The headphones were disconnected and were clearly broken (the competitor had cut the headphone cables). The WRC decided to keep the result, indicating that headphones that are clearly broken can be considered non-electronic for the purposes of 2i. As a kind reminder, disconnected headphones are NOT allowed if they still have electronic parts (see [2i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i))

translation.title: 选手比赛时使用明显损坏的耳机
translation.content:
发现一名选手比赛时戴着耳机。耳机未连接且明显损坏，选手已经剪断耳机线。WRC 决定保留成绩，指出在 2i 的语境下，明显损坏的耳机可视为非电子设备。

提醒：仅断开连接、但仍保有电子部件的耳机**不允许**使用（见 [2i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i)）。
